name: Verified Tools

sources.title: Submit your tool — full public form with all fields and 4 plans (Free $0 7-9wk queue / Starter $12 / Pro $129 / Premium $249)

conditions: Free tier: 7-9 week review queue (~889 tools ahead), nofollow link — dofollow only if you embed their badge
$12 Starter skips the queue (24h) with a permanent dofollow link — effectively the practical route
A claim link is emailed post-submit; you must sign in with the SAME email to manage the listing
requirements: Tagline ≤100 chars, short description ≤160, full description ≤1000
Logo: SVG/PNG preferred, max 512×512px, auto-compressed over 200KB
1-3 screenshots REQUIRED: 16:9 aspect, max 1600px width; first image becomes the featured image
Optional: YouTube demo URL, social links, affiliate-program checkbox (appears on their SaaS affiliate pages)
preparation: Tight copy: ≤60-char name, ≤100-char tagline, ≤160-char short desc, ≤1000-char description
The email you'll use to sign in — the claim link binds to it
Decide plan: free (7-9wk, nofollow) vs $12 (24h, dofollow) vs $129/$249 featured tiers
workflow: Fill all required fields and upload logo + screenshots
Submit; claim link goes to the email given — sign in with that email to manage
Free: wait ~7-9 weeks; paid: reviewed within 24h
watchFor: Free queue is honest but long (889 tools deep as of Sept 2026)
Free link is nofollow — dofollow requires badge embed or any paid plan
The claim email must match your sign-in email or 'you won't see your submission'
$129/$249 tiers add homepage featuring, full review with images, X posts, and a 5-min YouTube review (Premium)
countsAsLive: The tool has a public page on verifiedtools.info reachable from the directory/tools index
unknowns: Whether the badge-embed dofollow upgrade is verified automatically
What 'monitoring' (nav item) covers for listed tools
